srList.sentence: PARTICIPANTS AND METHODS One-hundred and six community-dwelling individuals (66 males and 40 females) over the age of 65, who required supportcare under Japans long-term care insurance system (LTCI)15 ) (support level 1, level 2, or care level 1) and were receiving day care through the LTCI, were enrolled.
